B. They possess an open circulatory system with a dorsal heart.
- This statement is incorrect. Arthropods have an open circulatory system, but it is not specifically described as having a dorsal heart. The open circulatory system in arthropods is characterized by a network of fluid-filled vessels called hemocoel, which surrounds the internal organs.

C. They are members of a biologically unsuccessful phylum incapable of exploiting diverse habitats and nutrition sources.
- This statement is incorrect. Arthropods are actually one of the most successful and diverse groups of organisms on Earth, with a wide range of habitats and nutrition sources. They include insects, arachnids, crustaceans, and others that have adapted to almost every conceivable environment.

D. They lack paired, jointed appendages.
